Here is a full transcription of the Latin baptismal register entries from `image_ef18cd.png`.

The entries are written in a standard Latin formula typical of 19th-century Catholic parish registers in Ireland. The standard format reads: *Die [Day] [Name of child], filius/filia [son/daughter] of [Father's name] et [Mother's name]. Spons[ores] [Sponsors/Godparents].* The priest has signed the abbreviation *Joannes Quinlan cc* (Coadjutor Curate) next to the majority of the entries.

---

## Left Page: 1875

### In Mense Julii (In the Month of July)

* **Die 30mo** Ellena, filia Joannis Kelly, et Catherinae Horan. Spons[ores]: Patritio Hartigan et Elizabeth Connell. *Joannes Quinlan cc*

---

### 1876 — In Mense Januarii (In the Month of January)

* **Die 5to** Honora, filia Jacobi Sullivan et Brigidae Shier. Spons[ores]: Patritio Shea et Brigida Fox. *Joannes Quinlan cc*
* **Die 13tio** Saneta [?], filia Patritii Bourke, et Margaritae Power. Spons[ores]: Joanne Power, et Brigida Power. *Joannes Quinlan cc*
> *Marginal Note on last entry:* "Sancta Bourke matrimonium contraxit cum Martino Liston in Ecclesia apud Broome, die 23a Februarii 1909." *(Sancta Bourke contracted marriage with Martin Liston in the church at Broome, on the 23rd day of February 1909.)*
